title: BlueprintAgent: Constraint-Triggered Targeted Revisits for Simulation-Ready Generation from Scanned Structural Blueprints
abstract: arXiv:2609.07362v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Converting in-service reinforced-concrete (RC) building blueprints into simulation-ready models---structured frame representations that support deterministic FEM export and qualified-engineer review---underpins safety assessment and seismic retrofit, but the process remains manual. Direct prompting of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) over a scanned sheet is unreliable: outputs often violate engineering constraints on beam--column support, span count, or 3D continuity. We present BlueprintAgent (BPA), a constraint-triggered multimodal agent for simulation-ready frame extraction from scanned blueprints. BPA treats the MLLM as the primary reader and decision maker, with OCR and computer vision supplying localized evidence. Its central mechanism realizes engineering constraints as callable validators whose entity-level conflict reports trigger targeted MLLM revisits over the local region---an inference-time control distinct from fi

translated_title: BlueprintAgent：通过约束触发的定向重访从扫描结构图纸生成仿真就绪模型
translated_abstract: 将在役钢筋混凝土（RC）建筑图纸转换为仿真就绪模型——即支持确定性有限元（FEM）导出与合格工程师审查的结构化框架表示——是安全评估与抗震加固的基础，但这一过程目前仍依赖人工完成。直接对扫描图纸使用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）提示并不可靠：输出常常违反梁柱支承、跨数或三维连续性方面的工程约束。我们提出了BlueprintAgent（BPA），一个用于从扫描图纸中提取仿真就绪结构框架的约束触发式多模态智能体。BPA将MLLM作为主要的阅读器和决策者，OCR与计算机视觉为其提供局部证据。其核心机制将工程约束实现为可调用的验证器，验证器生成的实体级冲突报告会触发MLLM对局部区域的定向重访——这是一种推理时的控制机制，有别于基于微调的方法。
tldr: 提出BlueprintAgent，一种将工程约束实现为可调用验证器、并在约束冲突时触发多模态大模型对局部图纸区域定向重访的多模态智能体，能够从扫描结构图纸中可靠地提取可用于仿真导出的结构框架模型。
en_tdlr: BlueprintAgent is a constraint-triggered multimodal agent that implements engineering constraints as callable validators whose entity-level conflict reports trigger targeted MLLM revisits of local blueprint regions, enabling reliable simulation-ready frame extraction from scanned structural drawings.
